A.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL 15 MINUTE) AS ts, count() AS value FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE serviceName = 'af-api' AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_datetime}} AND {{.end_datetime}} AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts
